full_name_ar: بشير بن زيد الضبعي ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba lists him as Bashir bin Yazid al-Duba'i and notes that al-Baghawi gives the name as Bashir bin Zayd. It quotes Ibn al-Sakan that his hadith is counted among the Basrans, and Ibn Abi Hatim from his father that he was a companion.
research_evidence: ٧٠٩- بشير بن يزيد الضبعيّ. ووقع عند البغويّ بشير بن زيد. قال ابن السّكن: حديثه في البصريين.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عبد الله بن معرض ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 4984) lists Abd Allah bin Mu'arrid al-Bahili. It cites a report via al-Baghawi, Ibn Abi Dawud and al-Tabari, through Khalifa bin Khayyat, that he came to the Prophet in a delegation and the Prophet set an obligatory levy on their camels, and Ibn Hajar calls the chain unusual (gharib). It also notes Ibn Qani's differing version of the name and chain.
research_evidence: عن جده عبد اللَّه بن معرّض الباهلي- أنه وفد على رسول اللَّه صلى اللَّه عليه وسلّم، فجعل له رسول اللَّه صلى اللَّه عليه وسلّم فريضة في إبلهم
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: جابر بن عبد الله بن جابر ( رضي الله عنه
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)
bio_auto: Recorded in the classical narrator registers; none of his hadith appear in the 39 collections held here. Listed among the Companions. No recorded death year survives; the timeline position is an estimate. Entry 7046 at muslimscholars.info.

full_name_ar: بن مسعدة صاحب الجيوش ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba identifies Ibn Mas'ada 'Sahib al-Juyush' as Abd Allah bin Mas'ada bin Hakama al-Fazari, a younger companion captured in a raid on Banu Fazara and given by the Prophet to one of his daughters. It says he got the title 'master of the armies' because he was appointed to lead armies against the Byzantines in the days of Mu'awiya, and cites a hadith through Ibn Jurayj whose chain has a break.
research_evidence: وأخرجوا من طريق ابن جريج، عن عثمان بن أبي سليمان، عن ابن مسعدة صاحب الجيوش
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمرو بن مالك العكي ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba says Amr bin Malik al-Akki came with Abu Musa al-Ash'ari in the delegation of the Ash'aris, citing Ibn Sa'd, and that al-Dhahabi added him. Ibn Hajar notes Ibn Sa'd's chapter on delegations mentions two unnamed men from Akk among that delegation.
research_evidence: ٥٩٦٧- عمرو بن مالك العكي قدم مع أبي موسى الأشعريّ في وفد الأشعريين، قاله ابن سعد، واستدركه الذهبي
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عبد الرحمن بن عديس ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba gives him as Abd al-Rahman bin Udays bin Amr bin Kilab, Abu Muhammad al-Balawi, describing him as among those who pledged allegiance under the tree and who took part in the conquest of Egypt, where he settled. It also notes his part in the expedition against Uthman during the civil strife.
research_evidence: عبد الرحمن بن عديس : بمهملتين مصغرا، ابن عمرو بن كلاب بن دهمان، أبو محمد البلوي
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: الضحاك بن سفيان بن الحارث ( رضي الله عنه

possible_duplicate_of.core_famous: Abu Sufyan bin al-Harith bin Qays

bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba gives his lineage as al-Dahhak bin Sufyan bin al-Harith of Banu Sulaym (al-Sulami). It quotes Ibn al-Kalbi that he was a companion, and says Ibn Sa'd, Ibn al-Barqi and Ibn Hibban likewise mention him and all state the Prophet tied a banner for him.
research_evidence: ٤١٨٥- الضحاك بن سفيان بن الحارث بن زائدة بن عبد اللَّه بن حبيب بن مالك ابن خفاف بن امرئ القيس بن بهثة بن سليم السلميّ
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: بن أبي العوجاء ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba names Ibn Abi al-Awja' al-Sulami as al-Akhram bin Abi al-Awja' al-Sulami. It cites a report from al-Zuhri that the Prophet sent him in the year 7 at the head of a raiding party of fifty men to Banu Sulaym.
research_evidence: ٥٨- الأخرم بن أبي العوجاء السلمي. روى عن الزهري أن النبي صلّى اللَّه عليه وسلم بعث الأخرم هذا في سنة سبع في سرية خمسين رجلا إلى بني سليم
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: أبو حصين السلمي ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba lists Abu Husayn al-Sulami as mentioned by al-Baghawi. It cites a report by al-Waqidi through Jabir that Abu Husayn al-Sulami came with gold from a mine and brought it to the Prophet, followed by a long hadith.
research_evidence: ٩٧٧٧- أبو حصين السلمي: ذكره البغوي ... قدم أبو حصين السلمي بذهب من معدن، فأتى به رسول اللَّه صلى اللَّه عليه وسلّم
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: مسعود بن رخيلة ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 7961) gives his lineage as Mas'ud bin Rukhayla bin A'idh of the Ashja' tribe. It says he led Ashja' at the Battle of the Confederates (al-Ahzab) and later accepted Islam sincerely, and cites al-Tabari and Umar bin Shabba that Ashja' sent a delegation of seven hundred led by him.
research_evidence: مسعود بن رخيلة: بالخاء المعجمة مصغرا، ابن عائذ بن مالك بن حبيب بن نبيح بن ثعلبة بن قنفد بن خلاوة بن سبيع بن بكر بن أشجع الأشجعيّ
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: جارية بن حميل ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba gives his lineage as Jariya bin Humayl bin Nushba bin Qurt al-Ashja'i and quotes al-Tabari that he accepted Islam and accompanied the Prophet, as reported by al-Daraqutni and others. The entry also reports that he witnessed Badr and, according to Ibn al-Barqi, was martyred at Uhud.
research_evidence: ١٠٤٨- جارية بن حميل - بمهملة مصغرا- ابن نشبة بن قرط الأشجعيّ. قال الطّبريّ: أسلم وصحب النبيّ صلّى اللَّه عليه وسلم
dod_s: Died at: Battle of Uhud — 3 AH / c. 624 CE (year of the event)

full_name_ar: الهيثم بن نصر ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba lists al-Haytham bin Nasr bin Dahr al-Aslami and says al-Waqidi counted him among those who served the Prophet. It quotes a report through al-Waqidi in which he says he served the Prophet and kept to his door among a group of needy people.
research_evidence: الهيثم بن نصر بن دهر الأسلميّ. ذكره الواقديّ فيمن خدم النبيّ صلّى اللَّه عليه وآله وسلّم
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: سنان بن وبر ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba lists Sinan bin Wabra (or Wabr) al-Juhani, an ally of Banu al-Harith bin al-Khazraj. It quotes Ibn Abi Hatim that he heard Abd Allah bin Ubayy say the words of Surat al-Munafiqun 63:8, and cites al-Tabarani's report that he was with the Prophet on the raid of Banu al-Mustaliq. It quotes Abu Umar (Ibn Abd al-Barr) that he is the one who quarrelled with Jahjah al-Ghifari over water.
research_evidence: ٣٥٢٥- سنان بن وبرة: أو وبر، الجهنيّ، حليف بني الحارث بن الخزرج.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: بن حديدة الجهني ( رضي الله عنه
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)
bio_auto: Recorded in the classical narrator registers; none of his hadith appear in the 39 collections held here. Listed among the Companions. No recorded death year survives; the timeline position is an estimate. Entry 7057 at muslimscholars.info.

full_name_ar: رفاعة بن عرادة ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba lists Rifa'a bin Araba, also given as Arada, al-Juhani al-Madani, among the companions. Its footnotes refer to his entries in Usd al-Ghaba and al-Isti'ab.
research_evidence: ٢٦٧٨- رفاعة بن عرابة: وقيل عرادة, الجهني المدني.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: العلاء بن جارية ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba lists al-Ala' bin Jariya al-Thaqafi, an ally of Banu Zuhra. It cites Ibn Ishaq's al-Maghazi, from Abd Allah bin Abi Bakr and others, that he was among those to whom the Prophet gave a share of the Hunayn spoils.
research_evidence: ٥٦٥٧ ز- العلاء بن جارية: بالجيم والتحتانية، الثقفي، حليف بني زهرة. ذكر ابن إسحاق في «المغازي» عن عبد اللَّه بن أبي بكر وغيره أنه ممّن أعطاه رسول اللَّه
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: يزيد بن المحجل ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 9327) lists Yazid ibn al-Muhajjal al-Harithi among the companions. The entry only refers the reader to where he was already mentioned, under Yazid ibn 'Abd al-Madan and Qays ibn al-Husayn.
research_evidence: يزيد بن المحجّل الحارثي تقدّم في يزيد بن عبد المدان، وفي قيس بن الحصين.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عقبة بن نمر ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 5630) says 'Uqba ibn Nimr (also called Ibn Murr) is mentioned in the Prophet's letter to Zur'a ibn Dhi Yazan, according to al-Mustaghfiri. Ibn Hajar refers to his mention under al-Harith ibn 'Abd Kulal and notes that Ibn Ishaq says he came to the Prophet in a delegation.
research_evidence: عقبة بن نمر: ويقال ابن مر. وله ذكر في كتاب النبيّ صلى اللَّه عليه وسلّم إلى زرعة بن ذي يزن، قاله المستغفري.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: منقذ بن حيان ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 8255) lists Munqidh ibn Habban al-'Abdi (spelled Habban there) among the companions. It says he was the son of al-Ashajj's sister and refers to his earlier mention in the entry on Suhar (ibn al-'Abbas al-'Abdi).
research_evidence: منقذ بن حبّان العبديّ: تقدّم ذكره في ترجمة صحار، وهو ابن أخت الأشجّ.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمرو بن المرجوم ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 5973) lists 'Amr ibn al-Marjum al-'Abdi among the companions. It quotes Ibn Sa'd that he came to the Prophet with the 'Abd al-Qays delegation.
research_evidence: عمرو بن المرجوم: العبديّ. قال ابن سعد: قدم في وفد عبد القيس.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: شهاب بن المتروك ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 3952) says Shihab ibn al-Matruk was one of the 'Abd al-Qays delegation, on the authority of Ibn Sa'd. Ibn Sa'd adds that his father's (al-Matruk's) real name was 'Abbad ibn 'Ubayd.
research_evidence: شهاب بن المتروك أحد وفد عبد القيس، قاله ابن سعد. قال: واسم أبيه عباد بن عبيد
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: جارية بن جابر ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 1047) says Jariya ibn Jabir al-'Asri was one of the 'Abd al-Qays delegation, as mentioned by al-Rushati. Ibn Hajar suspects he is the Juwayriya al-'Asri mentioned by Ibn Manda, and notes he appears in the entry on Suhar ibn al-'Abbas al-'Abdi as one of those who came with al-Ashajj and accepted Islam.
research_evidence: جارية بن جابر العصري، أحد وفد عبد القيس- ذكره الرشاطيّ
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: همام بن ربيعة ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 9015, Hammam ibn Rabi'a al-'Asri) says al-Rushati listed him among the 'Abd al-Qays delegation that came to the Prophet, and called him one of their chiefs and horsemen, citing Abu 'Ubayda Ma'mar ibn al-Muthanna. Ibn Hajar adds that he was already mentioned in the entry on Suhar ibn al-'Abbas.
research_evidence: ذكره الرّشاطيّ فيمن وفد على النبيّ صلّى اللَّه عليه وآله وسلّم من عبد قيس، قال: وكان من سادتهم وفرسانهم
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عقبة بن جروة ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 5607) describes 'Uqba ibn Jarwa al-'Abdi as one of the 'Abd al-Qays delegation, citing Ibn Sa'd. It notes he appears in the entry on Suhar ibn al-'Abbas among the delegates who came with al-Ashajj and accepted Islam.
research_evidence: عقبة بن جروة: العبديّ، أحد وفد عبد القيس. ذكره ابن سعد
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: سفيان بن همام ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 3342) says Sufyan ibn Hammam al-Muharibi was from Muharib of 'Abd al-Qays (or, less likely, Muharib Khasafa). Ibn Abi 'Asim, Ibn al-Sakan, al-Tabarani and Ibn Shahin record through his descendants that the Prophet told him: 'Forbid your people from nabidh made in earthenware jars.'
research_evidence: سفيان بن همام المحاربيّ: من محارب عبد القيس. وقيل من محارب خصفة. والأول أصحّ.
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: أبو الخطاب قال ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba (entry 9843) quotes Abu Umar (Ibn Abd al-Barr) that he was a companion whose name is unknown, with a single hadith on the witr prayer narrated by Thuwayr ibn Abi Fakhita. Al-Baghawi says he lived in Kufa, and Abu Ahmad al-Hakim notes al-Khuza'i listed him among companions known only by their kunya.
research_evidence: سمعت رجلا من أصحاب رسول اللَّه صلى اللَّه عليه وسلّم يقال له أبو الخطاب، وسئل عن الوتر
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: بن سيلان قال ( رضي الله عنه
bio: The page, quoting Usd al-Ghaba of Ibn al-Athir, lists him as 'Abd Allah ibn Silan, counted among the Kufans, and states he had companionship (lahu suhba). Qays ibn Abi Hazim narrated from him, and his hadith was transmitted by Bayan ibn Bishr from Qays; the hafiz Abu 'Ali al-Naysaburi gave his name as 'Abd Allah.
research_evidence: ابن سيلان، له صحبة، روى حديثه بيان بْن بشر، عن قيس، عنه
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: عمير ذو مران ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 4088 in Ibn al-Athir's Usd al-Ghaba fi Ma'rifat al-Sahaba (marked as covered by Ibn 'Abd al-Barr, Ibn Mandah and Abu Nu'aym). 'Umayr Dhu Murran, a chief (qayl) of Hamdan, was the grandfather of Mujalid bin Sa'id. The Prophet wrote to him; the entry gives the letter addressed to him and the Muslims of Hamdan, guaranteeing protection of their lives and property and commending Malik bin Murara al-Rahawi.
research_evidence: عمير ذو مران القيل بْن أفلح بْن شراحيل بْن رَبِيعة وهو ناعط بْن مرثد الهمداني. كتب إِلَيْه النَّبِيّ ﷺ وهو جد مجالد بْن سَعِيدِ
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: مالك بن حيدة ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 7634 in Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba. Malik bin Hayda al-Qushayri was the brother of Mu'awiya bin Hayda, the grandfather of Bahz bin Hakim. Ahmad (Musnad) transmits via Abu Qaza'a from Hakim bin Mu'awiya that Malik asked his brother Mu'awiya to go with him to the Prophet to ask for the release of his neighbours; al-Tabarani records the story with different wording.
research_evidence: مالك بن حيدة القشيري: أخو معاوية جد بهز بن حكيم، أخرجه أحمد، من طريق أبي قزعة، عن حكيم بن معاوية، عن أبيه
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: علاثة بن شجار ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 5669 in Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba. 'Ulatha bin Shajjar al-Saliti was of Banu Salit bin al-Harith bin Yarbu'; he is reported to have heard the Prophet say 'A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim.' Al-Bukhari cites 'Ali bin al-Madini about him, and some sources give his name as 'Allam bin Shajjar.
research_evidence: علاثة بن شجّار: بفتح المعجمة وتشديد الجيم، وقيل بكسر أوله ثم تخفيف السليطي. من بني سليط بن الحارث بن يربوع
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: حريث بن حسان ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 1135 in Ibn al-Athir's Usd al-Ghaba fi Ma'rifat al-Sahaba (covered by Abu Nu'aym, Ibn 'Abd al-Barr and Abu Musa). Hurayth bin Hassan al-Shaybani, also called al-Harith, was the delegate of Bakr bin Wa'il to the Prophet and is the man in the story of Qayla bint Makhrama; his fuller account is given under al-Harith.
research_evidence: حريث بْن حسان الشيباني وقيل الحارث وقد تقدم في الحارث وخبره هناك مذكور وهو صاحب قيلة بنت مخرمة، وهو وافد بكر بْن وائل
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: أبو حية التميمي ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 9809 in the kunya section of Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba. Ibn Hajar states that Abu Hayya al-Tamimi's name was Habis and refers the reader to his entry in the names section.
research_evidence: أبو حية التميمي: اسمه حابس- تقدم في الأسماء
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: أبان المحاربي من ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 4 in Ibn al-Athir's Usd al-Ghaba fi Ma'rifat al-Sahaba (covered by Ibn 'Abd al-Barr, Ibn Mandah and Abu Nu'aym). Aban al-Muharibi was one of the 'Abd al-Qays delegation that came to the Prophet. A report via al-Hakam bin Aban has him see the Prophet raise his hands toward the qibla; the entry states that al-Muharibi and al-'Abdi are the same man, Muharib being a clan of 'Abd al-Qays.
research_evidence: أبان المحاربي كان أحد الذين قدموا عَلَى رَسُول اللَّهِ ﷺ من عبد القيس. أخرجه ثلاثتهم
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: سنان بن غرفة ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 3522 in Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba (the entry begins on the previous page, noting Ibn Mufarrij's vocalisation of Ghurfa). Al-Bawardi, Ibn al-Sakan and al-Tabarani transmitted via Busr bin 'Ubaydullah from Sinan bin Ghurfa, who was a companion, a hadith that a woman who dies among men who are not her close relatives is given tayammum instead of being washed, and likewise a man.
research_evidence: وروى الباورديّ وابن السّكن والطّبرانيّ، من طريق بسر بن عبيد اللَّه، عن سنان بن غرفة، وكانت له صحبة
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: مازن بن خيثمة ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 7600 in Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba. Mazin bin Khaythama of al-Sakun (Kinda); Ibn 'Asakir, in the entry on his grandson 'Amr bin Qays, says he was a companion. Al-Tabarani's al-Mu'jam al-Awsat reports that Mu'adh bin Jabal sent him with Wahbil bin Ka'b as envoys to the Prophet after which the Sakasik and Sakun stopped fighting and became Muslim.
research_evidence: مازن بن خيثمة: السكونيّ الكندي. قال ابن عساكر في ترجمة حفيده عمرو بن قيس: له صحبة
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)

full_name_ar: أبو سفيان مدلوك ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Entry 7877 in Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba (the kunya section, entry 10031, cross-refers Abu Sufyan to Mudlik). Mudlik al-Fazari, a client (mawla) of Fazara with the kunya Abu Sufyan; Ibn Abi Hatim said he was a companion, and Muhammad bin Sa'd listed him among the companions who settled in al-Sham.
research_evidence: مدلوك الفزاري مولاهم، أبو سفيان. قال ابن أبي حاتم: له صحبة. وذكره محمد بن سعد فيمن نزل الشام من الصحابة

full_name_ar: أبو مريم الغساني ( رضي الله عنه
